mechanism: Bind the two actual equal rotation-radius sides ST and TV as a blue pair and the existing dotted SV as the base. The hypothesized error is returning the isosceles base angle TSV=25 instead of subtracting it from RST=60 to obtain requested RSV=35.
substantive_difference: Old unit20 saved no PNG or calls, rejecting unsupported new equalities. This design uses only true equal rotation radii and targets the intermediate-versus-requested angle frame, with no new equality/angle relation.
primary_unique_math_proof: RST and TUV are equilateral and congruent, so TS=TV. In the shown ray order ST,RT,VT at T, angle STV=60+70=130 degrees.
Isosceles STV has angle TSV=(180-130)/2=25. Ray SV lies within RST at S, so RSV=60-25=35, uniquely D.
The marked base-angle frame is a real intermediate triangle. It is not the requested angle and no mark is a new relation symbol. The original 70-degree arc and target arc remain black.

marker_roles.role: First actual equal leg ST of isosceles STV; true rotation-radius information.
Second actual equal leg TV, paired to ST without equality ticks.
Existing dotted base links the equal legs and shares the target ray SV; original dotted style retained.

human_semantics: Numerical geometry/measurement question. Colors are comparison groups, not tick marks, angle symbols, new units, fills or constraints. Every original text and count target remains. Specific false relationships are hypotheses of model error; they are not asserted as added givens. Native visual review required before calls.
